study type: randomized controlled trial, mixed longitudinal study
outcome: serum ferritin levels at 3 months PMA
cohort: Moderately preterm neonates of 30 to 33 weeks gestation born in a level III unit in Northern India.
finding: Placental transfusion (delayed cord clamping or cord milking) resulted in significantly higher serum ferritin at discharge compared to early cord clamping in preterm neonates of 30-33 weeks gestation.
